# Halo craft study Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a private static marketing site for fictional Northlane / Halo that studies sunday.ai craft (structure, sticky chapters, curtain transitions, scrub media, FAQ) in plain HTML/CSS/JS + GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis.

**Architecture:** Multi-page static site generated by a small Python include build (`build.py`) that injects shared header/footer into page templates. Runtime motion boots from `js/main.js`, which wires Lenis to GSAP and loads page modules. Preview ships as flat files under `dist/` with noindex.

**Tech Stack:** HTML5, CSS (custom properties), vanilla JS (ES modules), GSAP 3 + ScrollTrigger (CDN), Lenis (CDN), Python 3 `build.py`, GitHub Pages-ready `dist/`.

## Global Constraints

- No Sunday/Memo IP (logo, copy, photos, video, fonts).
- Fictional brand only: Northlane, Halo, Capture Sleeve™.
- Stock-safe or owned media only.
- Animate `transform` and `opacity` only; reduced-motion fallbacks required.
- Anti-slop: no warm beige AI template look, no giant default serif hero, no black pill CTA forest.
- Preview: `noindex`, `robots.txt` Disallow `/`, `.nojekyll`; never touch yar.website or `yaroshidi/web-starter-template`.
- Prefer link-only updates to Yar (no screenshots unless asked).
- Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-sunday-craft-study-design.md`.

### Task 1: Scaffold + tokens + build pipeline

**Files:**
- Create: `build.py`, `src/partials/{head,header,footer,scripts}.html`, `src/templates/index.html` (minimal), `src/css/{tokens,base,layout,components,motion}.css`, `src/js/main.js` (empty boot), `robots.txt`, `.nojekyll`, `README.md`, `package-lock` none
- Test: run `python3 build.py` and open `dist/index.html` structure

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `build.py` writes `dist/` mirroring routes; partials use `{{title}}` and `{{active}}` simple replace
- Consumes: none

- [ ] **Step 1: Create `build.py`**

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = ROOT / "src"
DIST = ROOT / "dist"

ROUTES = {
    "index.html": "",
    "technology.html": "technology",
    "design.html": "design",
    "company.html": "company",
    "beta.html": "beta",
    "journal.html": "journal",
    "journal-hello-halo.html": "journal/hello-halo",
    "privacy.html": "legal/privacy",
    "terms.html": "legal/terms",
    "404.html": "404",
}

def load(name: str) -> str:
    return (SRC / "partials" / name).read_text()

def inject(template: str, *, title: str, path_prefix: str) -> str:
    head = load("head.html").replace("{{title}}", title).replace("{{prefix}}", path_prefix)
    header = load("header.html").replace("{{prefix}}", path_prefix)
    footer = load("footer.html").replace("{{prefix}}", path_prefix)
    scripts = load("scripts.html").replace("{{prefix}}", path_prefix)
    html = template
    html = html.replace("{{head}}", head)
    html = html.replace("{{header}}", header)
    html = html.replace("{{footer}}", footer)
    html = html.replace("{{scripts}}", scripts)
    html = html.replace("{{prefix}}", path_prefix)
    return html

def title_for(name: str) -> str:
    mapping = {
        "index.html": "Halo — The quiet housemate",
        "technology.html": "Technology — Northlane",
        "design.html": "Design — Northlane",
        "company.html": "Company — Northlane",
        "beta.html": "Beta — Northlane",
        "journal.html": "Journal — Northlane",
        "journal-hello-halo.html": "Hello Halo — Journal",
        "privacy.html": "Privacy — Northlane",
        "terms.html": "Terms — Northlane",
        "404.html": "Not found — Northlane",
    }
    return mapping[name]

def prefix_for(subdir: str) -> str:
    if not subdir or subdir == "404":
        return "."
    depth = subdir.count("/") + 1
    return "/".join([".."] * depth)

def copy_static():
    import shutil
    for folder in ("css", "js", "assets"):
        src, dst = SRC / folder, DIST / folder
        if src.exists():
            if dst.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(dst)
            shutil.copytree(src, dst)
    for name in ("robots.txt", ".nojekyll"):
        p = ROOT / name
        if p.exists():
            shutil.copy2(p, DIST / name)

def main():
    if DIST.exists():
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(DIST)
    DIST.mkdir(parents=True)
    for fname, subdir in ROUTES.items():
        tpl_path = SRC / "templates" / fname
        if not tpl_path.exists():
            continue
        prefix = prefix_for(subdir)
        html = inject(tpl_path.read_text(), title=title_for(fname), path_prefix=prefix)
        out_dir = DIST if not subdir or subdir == "404" else DIST / subdir
        if subdir == "404":
            out = DIST / "404.html"
        else:
            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            out = out_dir / "index.html" if subdir else DIST / "index.html"
        out.write_text(html)
        print("wrote", out.relative_to(ROOT))
    copy_static()
    print("build ok")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### Task 2: Global shell — header, footer, curtain

**Files:**
- Create: `src/js/curtain.js`
- Modify: `src/partials/header.html`, `footer.html`, `src/css/components.css`, `motion.css`, `src/js/main.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `initCurtain()` — intercepts same-origin internal `<a>` clicks, plays cover → `location.href` assign (full navigation is fine for MPA; curtain on exit; optional `sessionStorage` flag for enter animation)
- Consumes: GSAP global

- [ ] **Step 1: Markup** — header with Northlane wordmark (text), links Home / Technology / Design / Company / Journal / Beta; footer with legal links; `#curtain` fixed full-viewport div.

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement `curtain.js`**

```js
export function initCurtain() {
  const el = document.getElementById("curtain");
  if (!el || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
  const entering = sessionStorage.getItem("halo-curtain") === "1";
  if (entering) {
    sessionStorage.removeItem("halo-curtain");
    gsap.set(el, { autoAlpha: 1 });
    gsap.to(el, { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power2.out", delay: 0.05 });
  }
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const a = e.target.closest("a[href]");
    if (!a) return;
    const url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
    if (url.origin !== location.origin) return;
    if (a.target === "_blank" || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) return;
    if (url.pathname === location.pathname && url.hash) return; // in-page
    e.preventDefault();
    sessionStorage.setItem("halo-curtain", "1");
    gsap.to(el, {
      autoAlpha: 1,
      duration: 0.45,
      ease: "power2.inOut",
      onComplete: () => { location.href = url.href; },
    });
  });
}
```
